description: List the Common Crawl monthly crawl collections (crawl ids like "CC-MAIN-2026-34") with the date range each one covers. AUTHORITATIVE for "which Common Crawl snapshot covers <date>" — call this first to pick the crawl id that commoncrawl_index_search needs. Newest first. Keyless.

contains_date.description: Optional ISO date, e.g. "2025-01-15". Returns only the crawl(s) whose capture window covers that date — the answer to "which snapshot would have seen my page then".

limit.description: How many crawls to return, newest first. Default 20, max 120 (the full history back to 2008).

name: commoncrawl_crawls
title: Commoncrawl Crawls
